name: purple-skills
description: Catálogo open-source de skills para agentes de IA, com site público, painel admin e servidores MCP.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @purple-skills/shared && npm run build -w @purple-skills/db && npm run build -w @purple-skills/site && npm run build -w @purple-skills/admin && npm run build -w @purple-skills/mcp-public && npm run build -w @purple-skills/mcp-admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @purple-skills/shared && npm run build -w @purple-skills/db
